title.en: Layer environmental story clues by scale and reveal

summary: Stage fictional story evidence as large spatial consequence, mid-scale activity traces and close inspection details whose reveal state stays coherent.
objective: A viewer can form a broad situation from the entry view, refine it along the route, and inspect optional clues without a caption contradicting the visible scene state.
applies_when: A diorama, room or explorable scene should communicate what happened through space and props rather than exposition alone.
intent_signals: tell a workshop story through used tools and repair marks
layer clues from room scale to close inspection
keep environmental clues consistent after state changes
example_prompts: Tell the story of an interrupted greenhouse repair through route blockage, staged tools and one inspectable replacement part.
Show a closed archive wing reopening through room layout, moved carts, labels and a recovered object.
negative_signals: hide required information in tiny text
caption claims an event the scene cannot support
not_for: Claims about a real event, person or culture without evidence and review.
A puzzle whose required solution depends on inaccessible color, audio or precision pointing alone.

principles: Layer clues by reading distance: silhouette and blocked routes establish situation, grouped props show activity, surface marks and labels reward inspection.
Give each clue a question it helps answer and a state in which it is valid. Repetition should strengthen an inference, while contradiction should be deliberate and inspectable.
Keep essential progression cues perceivable through more than one channel or provide an equivalent companion description and action path.
Use absence, displacement, repair and changed access as clues alongside added objects; density alone does not create narrative.
Separate invented story evidence from factual evidence. A convincing fictional trace remains an authored proposal.
implementation: Write a clue matrix with intended inference, scale, location, reveal state, prerequisite, interaction and reset behavior. Mark clues as essential, supporting or atmospheric.

In Blender, compose large consequences first, then activity clusters and inspectable details. For the greenhouse, use a blocked service aisle, an open tool roll and a mismatched replacement valve; for the archive, use a reopened partition, relocated carts and a recovered case.
Model clues with physical attachment and plausible placement inside the fiction: tools rest on supports, labels belong to objects, trails connect locations and repair marks align with serviced parts.

Export stable clue and state identifiers plus authored bounds or anchors. Preserve source-only notes in the production manifest rather than assuming every Blender annotation or collection becomes runtime meaning.
In Three.js, reveal clues from one narrative state model, expose essential clues through selectable objects and companion text, and record inspected state separately from world state.
Reset restores world state, clue visibility, selection, camera and inspected progress according to the declared replay policy.
observable_checks: From each composition's entry view, state the broad situation without reading close labels; the route and major spatial consequence support it.
Follow the intended path and find at least one activity cluster and one optional close clue without turning all other props into noise.
Change the story from before to after: visible clues, labels, access and interactions update from the same state and no obsolete clue remains authoritative.
Reach every essential clue through the primary 3D interaction or its documented companion action and description.
Remove atmospheric clutter; the intended inference still follows from the essential and supporting clue layers.
Reset and replay both compositions; reveal order is deterministic where authored and optional discoveries do not corrupt world state.

creative_affordances: Use ambiguity by offering two plausible interpretations, provided the scene clearly distinguishes observed clues from conclusions.
Shift emphasis among architecture, objects, light, sound or character traces while retaining accessible equivalents for required clues.
known_limits: Authored fictional storytelling guidance; no audience comprehension, accessibility outcome or rendered scene was observed.
Visible traces do not prove real historical, forensic or behavioral conclusions.
